SPECIAL_FLIGHT_SYNTHESIZED_FROM_B03_2026.mechanism: Dandelion handler 0x8005C818 (plant_behaviors[6], plant type 8). Contact with a mature dandelion plant (requires the walker's selected slot plus extra_state bit 1, and the plant's own mature bit 2) calls 0x80046CAC, which detaches any currently-carried actor, clears player state fields 0x800A655C/657A/65A3, writes vy=-4096 (a strong upward launch), sets mode 5, zeroes fields +82/+84, sets +88=3, and plays positional sound 15. Live-confirmed in the Interpreter runtime trace (movies/Phase4/Interpreter/B03.movie.json): the trigger fires once at movie frame 180, terminal vy peaks then settles to 350 by frame 261, with 212 latch-active updates and active VX/VZ steering (the player can steer during the glide, not a fixed trajectory), apex rise measured at exactly 30,720 units, ending in a native grounded state at frame 717 with the latch auto-clearing at frame 719.
SPECIAL_FLIGHT_SYNTHESIZED_FROM_B03_2026.propeller_updraft_interaction: A separate mechanism in the same handler family: a quantized 3D radius-40 test centered at the plant's own position (Y offset -0x7400) writes latch 11 to the player's power-state field (0x800A659E) unless a harvester-active bit is set. A propeller object (a distinct actor) consumes latch 11 within its own inner vertical band via an X/Z radius-40 test, applying vy-=512 and clamping the descent at -3072 -- i.e. propellers provide a SLOWER, sustained updraft rather than the dandelion's own single strong launch impulse. Both share the same power-state field (11=dandelion latch, 12=a separate player-contact-response latch, both cleared by the propeller handler).
